description: Kurume_City_Wi-Fi情報 [telecom] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 久留米市. 久留米市無料公衆無線LANサービス『KurumeCityWi-Fi』を設置していた位置情報等のデータです。 なお、インバウンド観光客等へWi-Fi環境を提供してきた、無料公衆無線LAN「KurumeCityWi-Fi」につきましては、機器のサポート終了、保守機器の枯渇およびモバイル通信環境の変化を踏まえ、令和７年３月31日(月)を... Coverage: 久留米市. The portal files it under the publisher 久留米市. Its tags are Kurume_City_Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi, 久留米市, 位置情報, 緯度経度. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
